Dates are only recorded from a region-specific source (the firm's own regional posting or careers page stating London or Milton Keynes). date_confidence: 'confirmed' = regional page/posting states this cycle explicitly; 'indicative' = regional source but rolling/prior-cycle/no year stated, or found via a search-engine summary of the regional posting rather than a direct fetch; 'unconfirmed' = no regional source seen yet, date fields left empty; 'not_applicable' = there is no scheme/date to confirm at all (used for Speculative-status entries where no formal placement track exists, as opposed to 'unconfirmed' which implies a scheme exists but its date wasn't found). Never alert on unconfirmed or not_applicable dates. Foreign-market (non-UK) dates are marked not_applicable rather than recorded. status: 'Speculative' is a fifth status alongside Open/Opens soon/Verify/Watch/Closed - for a real, London-relevant, small/boutique firm in scope (Consulting/Finance/AM/IB/Risk-Audit) where no live or historical Industrial Placement/Year-in-Industry posting could be found at all, but the firm is small enough that a direct, speculative approach (not an online application) is a realistic route in.
